explanation: Public data release tooling: scripts/public-export gains the shared public-safety guard, the data-release builder (data-release.mts, data-manifest.mjs, sources.mts), the KEGG and withheld-field stripping for browser bundles, and the public-repository overlays (fetch:data, data:offline, dev:offline, the Public safety CI job). A root data-release.json pins the published hypoexplorer-data release. These only shape what the public repositories receive; this repository's structure, app code, builders and runbooks are unchanged, so the startup map and catalog stay accurate. A follow-up typing fix in data-release.mts (reduce<number>) changes no behavior.
